note: Clean-night TIMING subset of unseen-throttle-p2-ab.json ([UnseenThrottle] phase 2, asi .0315): per-part --ab pairs (rate, footprint, cars, list, avoid), every part on BP rare-big-crowd and on IP; snap-back and stuck-Sim jobs stay daytime. Ordered by expected gain (docs/143 §8 table): BP crowd all parts, rate, IP all parts, footprint, cars, list, avoid. Needs the phase-2 commit merged (ts3native 0.36.15 ini keys, repro unseen-traffic, ts3fixes unseencars). Skip bp-ut2-list-* (-24 min) when clean-night-0.2.0 bp-ut-play-* ran on .0315; bp-ut2-avoid-* is last so a short night can stop before it (-24 min). Groups for --only / --from: bp-ut2-crowd-*, bp-ut2-rate-*, ip-ut2-all-*, bp-ut2-footprint-*, bp-ut2-cars-*, bp-ut2-list-*, bp-ut2-avoid-*. Reports: wait-ab.ts <tag>, profile-compare.mjs <tag>:on vs :off, unseen-report.ts <native.json> (throttle lines), hitch-attr-report.ts. 14 jobs, ~2.8 h real (168 min: profile minutes + ~2 min load each).

jobs.note: Clean night only (docs/TESTING.md clean-night rules: nothing else running, machine-load line < 10% other CPU, else rerun). [UnseenThrottle] phase 2 timing (docs/143 §8.6; timing subset of unseen-throttle-p2-ab.json, whose snap-back and stuck-Sim jobs run in the daytime). ts3native 0.36.15 (game-copy/ts3native.asi.0315, copy of native/ts3native/out/ts3native.asi from the phase-2 commit) with build/ts3fixes.package + build/ts3agent.package from the same commit installed (ts3fixes pushes the household positions and owns unseencars; an older ts3fixes leaves utWhy_7 / utAvWhy_7 / utRateWhy_7 'no viewers' taking every call: stop and install), run from a checkout whose native/ts3native/ts3native.ini is master with phase 2 merged: the job ini adds only the parts under test and HitchAttr. Ship config: [UnseenProbe] off (its per-agent classification costs time and would sit in both halves; the daytime p2 jobs read the probe classes). Seed 12345, story progression off. Pass for every job: no crash or freeze (a freeze = stop, triage against unseen.cpp UtPathWhy / the part under test), 0 watchdog lines, the switch line in the log at every slice, stuck Sims not above the off halves (docs/TESTING.md). Read: wait-ab.ts <tag> per key beyond the docs/136 per-key null (-1.5..+9.4 ms/s), no keyed wait higher, it/s and sim ms/s (profile-compare.mjs <tag>:on vs :off), hitch-attr-report.ts. Every part together (--ab unseenthrottle,unseenavoid,unseenfootprint,unseenrate,unseencars: all switch at once; expected ~25-45 ms/s, docs/143 §8 table), rare-big-crowd (many walking Sims, doors; waves from the window start, so the warm-up and first counted slice carry most of the crowd: the pair balances it). BP 10 min, 2-min slices (10, not the daytime queue's 8: 8 min gives off,on,on, one side short). Pass also: utSkipped, utAvSkipped, utFpSkipped, utRateSkipped > 0 in on slices only, utWhy_11 (portal) > 0. Read also utWhy / utAvWhy / utRateWhy mix. Off-first (warm-up on, then off,on,on,off); read with bp-ut2-crowd-onfirst (mean of both per-side deltas cancels the slot-1 bias, docs/136 §2).
